```sql
SELECT
  a.district,
  a.year,
  100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered AS anc4_rate,
  100.0 * m.institutional_deliveries / m.pregnancies_registered AS institutional_delivery_rate
FROM anc_visits a
JOIN maternal_services m
  ON a.district = m.district AND a.year = m.year
WHERE a.district IN ('Gaya','Nalanda')
  AND a.year IN (2022,2023)
ORDER BY a.district, a.year;
```
